scenes.basis: 23:1 "Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said" - the hearing before the council continues 22:30 in Jerusalem; 23:11 "as you have testified about me at Jerusalem"
23:16 "Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul" - the conspiracy and the report name no place; the barracks is in Jerusalem
23:23 "Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen" - the escort is arranged from the Jerusalem barracks; Caesarea is the destination, not yet the setting
23:31 "the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris"
23:33 "When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him"; 23:35 "He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace"
